Yes, both parts are right. Marking the NASA card as read took it out of the queue and left me with a friendly "all caught up" empty view — which is genuinely satisfying, it tells me I'm actually done with my reading pile rather than leaving me staring at a blank space wondering if something broke. And flipping over to "All bookmarks" showed the NASA link still sitting there, safe and sound.

That's exactly what I'd want: marking something read just clears it out of my "to read" pile, it doesn't throw the bookmark away. The two are different things in my mind, and this keeps them different. Happy with this.
